channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tim Connelly | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tim Connelly from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Matt Lloyd:

“The opportunity came up to sign Jonathan Kuminga, which again was the product of many, many phone calls and a lot of time investment. My wife asked me at one point, how many times has he called you? She was referencing Jonathan Kuminga's agent. How many times have you been on the phone with him since the middle of July? So I said, okay, I will look, and we went through my phone and we had 94 phone calls between July 15th to the day we signed Jonathan. Anthony Edwards was really instrumental in recruiting him to come here. We had several conversations with him, his representatives, and from Chris Finch to Tim Connelly to Alonzo Gee, who is on our staff, everything just came together.”

Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tomas Balcetis on Tim Connelly
item.description:
Balcetis told BasketNews.

“My former boss, Tim Connelly, was always a key factor. Throughout the whole process, he vouched for me to their management and really contributed a lot.”

Tomas Balcetis on Tim Connelly, Aug 18, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Alex Rodriguez on Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“When you talk about Tim Connelly, coach Finch and Anthony Edwards, especially because of Anthony’s age, having those three together is a great kind of foundation.”

Alex Rodriguez on Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jun 24, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Tim Connelly
item.description:
“Tim [Connelly] told me to my face that I was traded … It was gangster, I ain’t gon’ lie… It’s a tough situation regardless of what would have happened. But the fact that it happened that way, I got to give him respect.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Tim Connelly, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Open Court Basketball.

item.title: Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Michael Malone on Tim Connelly:

“I wouldn't have this job without Tim Connelly. Tim Connelly after my brief tenure in Sacramento and our time working together in New Orleans for many years, saw something in me, where he believed in me to tell Josh Kroenke I was the right guy for the job.”

Michael Malone on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly, May 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Rudy Gobert, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on the Timberwolves:

“When Tim Connelly made that trade (for Rudy Gobert) everybody was laughing at him and what he was doing. But he made a great team. I think he deserves credit for doing that.”

Nikola Jokic on Rudy Gobert, Tim Connelly, May 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tim Connelly
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Rick Carlisle on MIN:

“This is one of the best teams on the planet. These guys have really got it going here. The building is alive, the environment is way different than it used be. I take my hat off to Tim Connelly and his operation for everything they’ve done, new ownership.”

Rick Carlisle on Tim Connelly, Dec 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Tim Connelly
item.description:
Jaden McDaniels on his new deal:

“I just thank Tim [Connelly] and all the owners for the opportunity and believing in me. It’s a life-changing thing. It’s hit me, but it hasn’t hit me all the way yet.”

Jaden McDaniels on Tim Connelly, Oct 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Tim Connelly, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Calvin Booth on Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray’s reactions to Tim Connelly’s departure:

“Business as usual. I think both of them are comfortable with me and the vision I have for the team.”

Calvin Booth on Tim Connelly, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Jun 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Chris Finch on Tim Connelly
item.description:
Dane Moore:Chris Finch on what he told the Timberwolves ownership group about Tim Connelly (from his experience with him in Denver):

“As soon as you meet him, you’re gonna like him, and you’re gonna want him.”

Chris Finch on Tim Connelly, May 31, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Michael Malone on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Malone on Connelly:

“This past weekend with Tim talking to the Wizards, I didn’t want to see him leave, but I had complete confidence in Arturas Karnisovas. We wouldn’t have missed a beat. I am the head coach in Denver becasue of Tim Connelly…”

Michael Malone on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly, May 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Brett Brown on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly
item.description:
76ers coachBrett Brown on the Nuggets:

“I respect what they have built from afar. I’ve known Arturas for a long time. I’ve known Mike for a long time. Tim Connelly’s done a great job…Those three have built something that from afar you respect.”

Brett Brown on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly, Jan 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Tim Connelly, Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“Tim Connelly's not actively shopping Emmanuel Mudiay. That's just not accurate, it's not fair, and Emmanuel knows that.”

Michael Malone on Tim Connelly, Emmanuel Mudiay, Feb 3, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Wilson Chandler on Tim Connelly
item.description:
“And some guys say they're not going to trade you, and then they trade you. I'm not saying that (Nuggets general manager Tim Connelly) is that guy, but you never know. You can never feel too safe about anything.”

Wilson Chandler on Tim Connelly, Jan 14, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Brian Shaw on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Shaw confirmed that he had been hired by Denver during an exclusive interview with ESPNLosAngeles.com's Ramona Shelburne.

“I'm so appreciative for the opportunity to be able to lead this team and for the faith that [Nuggets team president] Josh Kroenke and [general manager] Tim Connelly have put in me,”

Brian Shaw on Josh Kroenke, Tim Connelly, Jun 24, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.
